explanation.question_quote: At his previous visit 4 months ago, a new drug was added to his treatment regimen. He reports that his dyspnea and peripheral edema have improved. His pulse is 70/min and blood pressure is 110/80 mm Hg. Physical examination shows bilateral, mildly tender enlargement of breast tissue.
explanation.sentence: After a new heart failure drug was added, the patient's dyspnea and edema improved, but examination revealed bilateral, mildly tender breast enlargement.
This finding is gynecomastia, a characteristic adverse effect of spironolactone due to its antiandrogen activity.
Spironolactone blocks aldosterone receptors in principal cells of the cortical collecting duct, reducing sodium reabsorption while sparing potassium.
